description: A photograph depicting a green urban area in Täby, Sweden. In the foreground, a grassy field with white-flowered plants extends across the image. Several medium-sized evergreen trees are prominent, with one large tree in the center foreground, and others positioned near and between the buildings in the midground and background. The midground features a light-coloured, multi-story building on the left and a smaller, brick-coloured building further back on the right. In the background, a taller, brick-coloured building is partially visible among trees on the right. The sky is overcast. The photo illustrates an example of "Green urban areas" for land cover classification. Credit: K. Larsson.
